rules: Use 960x540 design coordinates. A camera at x480,y270,zoom1 matches the wide stage.
The actor y coordinate is the foot baseline; its head sits about 220*scale pixels above it.
Check the raised hands, ears and antenna, not only the face. Text occupies screen-space y29–80.
A camera edit should preserve actions and actor positions. Revise only the named shot camera.
Shots partition [0,frames), with no overlaps/gaps. Review both sides of a cut for consistent gaze and identity.
inspection: Playable preview plus contact sheet/action-boundary frames; human or vision review for appeal.
stop: Stop when requested effect is reviewed or workflow budget is exhausted.
